Completion evidence: Gerrit 3364 merged as 9489d225d09 (LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, 0 unresolved), submitted 2026-11-12 00:57 PST.
- AC1 RED test: tests/unit/test_bedrock_vendor_profiles.py::test_agentic_run_on_a_meta_model_completes drives the real build_bedrock_provider (only boto3.session.Session is replaced) and failed on the pre-fix tree with LLMUnavailableError naming bedrock_supports_strict_tool_definition.
- AC2 root cause: pydantic-ai 1.107.9 models/bedrock.py:519 reads profile.bedrock_supports_strict_tool_definition directly; providers/bedrock.py model_profile returns a plain ModelProfile for meta and None for unknown vendors; upstream main reads it with a False default; 1.107.10 still has the direct read; rebar pins >=1.107,<2. Fixed rebar-side in build_bedrock_provider.
- AC3 tool turn: test_agentic_run_on_a_meta_model_completes_a_tool_turn (toolUse read_file, then end_turn; the 2nd Converse call carries the toolResult with the file content).
- AC4 live probe: recorded in the 2026-11-11 22:58 PST comment (3 requests, 2 tool calls, finish stop).
- AC5 classification: test_formerly_plain_profiles_classify_like_other_non_caching_bedrock_vendors plus the no-cachePoint assertion in the tool-turn test.
- AC6 every vendor: test_every_vendor_resolves_to_a_bedrock_profile_and_existing_ones_are_unchanged over 11 vendor prefixes plus an unknown one.
- AC7 make verify exit 0 on 17b45eee99d (same tree as 9489d225d09 for the changed files), 23:04-00:26 PST.
Found bugs filed discovered_from: saintly-creeded-gecko (default max_tokens over Maverick limit), tardy-coltish-swellfish (false cache-ineffective warning on non-caching Bedrock vendors).
